a: snapBackOrDelete's delete path deletes nested dragged ids separately, so a node already taken by its ancestor's cascade gets a second delete
A drop within one layout container counts the other dragged children as obstacles at their old poses
A layout container that refuses with a reason gets two refusal overlays (outline and reason text) when reparent-on-drop is on
b: A layout release translates the selection's non-layout roots itself, so page drop and reparent-on-drop never run for them
Descendants of a root landed in another frame are moved by the difference of two poses stored in different frames
